Company Description
Finforeca is a finance technology and services company focused on simplifying financial decision-making through Enterprise Finance AI and curated Finance Shared Services. The organization supports finance teams with strategic solutions such as Fractional CFO, FP&A, F&A, M&A, and Finance Business Partnering, backed by modern digital capabilities. A key offering is its Corporate Cash Flow Planning Platform, designed to improve clarity, agility, and forecasting for corporate liquidity. Finforeca’s mission is to revolutionize enterprise finance with technology-led solutions that align strategy, enhance visibility, and strengthen financial operations. With global, cross-industry experience, the company enables clients to modernize finance functions, improve cash planning, and drive data-informed decisions.

Role Description
The Finance Shared Services Specialist is a full-time remote role that supports core finance and accounting operations within Finforeca's shared services model: processing and reconciling financial transactions, maintaining accurate accounting records, and preparing and reviewing financial statements for US clients.
You will own the day-to-day books and month-end close for a portfolio of multiple US clients. That means the accounting is accurate, on time, US GAAP compliant and documented well enough that a fractional CFO, an auditor or an investor can rely on it without re-performing it. You will work inside each client's own accounting stack (mostly NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Xero and Acumatica), follow Finforeca's close checklists and controls, and escalate judgement calls to the CFO with a recommended answer rather than an open question. Day to day, this also means validating data in finance systems, supporting month-end and year-end close, responding to finance-related queries, documenting procedures, adhering to compliance standards, and using digital tools to improve efficiency and visibility across finance operations.

What you will do
Accounts payable and receivable: process vendor bills, approvals and payment runs in whichever AP workflow and accounting system the client uses; issue invoices, apply cash and run collections; maintain vendor and customer masters; track DSO, DPO and CEI.
Month-end close: bank and credit card reconciliations, accruals and prepaids, fixed assets and depreciation, intercompany, payroll journals and balance sheet reconciliations with supporting schedules; deliver the close package within the agreed number of business days.
Technical accounting schedules: revenue recognition (ASC 606), deferred contract costs (ASC 340-40), fixed assets (ASC 360) and inventory (ASC 330) where a client's business requires them, following the policy set by the CFO.
Cash, payroll and compliance: maintain the weekly cash position for the 13-week cash forecast; support US payroll processing on the client's payroll platform; prepare schedules for indirect tax filings, information returns, audits and tax return preparation by the client's external accountants.
Process and controls: document procedures for every recurring task; validate data flowing into client finance systems; respond to finance queries from client teams; support system implementations, module rollouts and migrations; identify automation opportunities and work with Finforeca's AI-assisted delivery tooling as it is introduced.

What you bring
4 to 7 years in accounting or finance operations, with at least 2 years on US client books in a KPO, outsourced accounting firm, shared services centre or US-headquartered company from India.
Hands-on experience in at least two of NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, Xero and Acumatica; Sage Intacct, Ramp.com or Bill.com experience is a plus.
Working knowledge of US GAAP: accruals, revenue recognition basics, fixed assets, prepaids and deferrals.
Strong Excel: lookups, pivots, reconciliations that tie out, clean schedules that someone else can follow.
B.Com, M.Com, MBA (Finance), CA Inter, CMA or ACCA (or equivalent); a completed CA or CPA is welcome but not required.
Clear written English, comfortable on video calls with US clients, and a habit of closing loops and documenting as you go.
Experience using AI tools to build financial statements, schedules, reconciliations and analysis in Excel or Google Sheets, and to produce related presentations or browser-based visualizations, is a plus.
Able to work an India-day schedule that extends to 10 to 11 PM IST on most days to overlap with US mornings.

What we offer
Competitive compensation: fixed CTC plus an annual performance bonus.
Fully remote, anywhere in India. Company-provided laptop, health insurance, PF and gratuity.
Direct exposure to US finance: CFO-level review, multiple industries and accounting stacks, audits and fundraising cycles.
Small team with direct access to the founder, and a path into Finance Shared Services Lead as the bench grows.

How to apply
Apply through LinkedIn and attach your CV; applications reach our hiring team directly. In your CV or a short cover note, tell us about the US client books you have run: systems used, close timelines you held, and the most complex reconciliation or accounting issue you resolved. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a brief practical exercise before interviews.

Overview

The Senior Analyst, IT Risk Management, will support our SOX Compliance program within the Finance Organization and will report into the US-based Manager, Risk Management. This position will primarily focus on scoping and evaluation of general and application IT controls. The Senior Analyst will be responsible for managing and executing various aspects of the program including IT scoping, delivery of the program, and reporting of results. The Senior Analyst will work closely with the US-based SOX team, worldwide IT departments, regional controllership, our shared services center, business owners, and our internal and external auditors, with the expectation of some overlap in the working hours.

Requirements for this position include extensive knowledge of IT general and application controls, strong understanding of IT control frameworks (e.g., COBIT, NIST Cybersecurity, NIST SP 800-53, CIS/SANS Top 20), familiarity with SEC/PCAOB regulations, COSO and US GAAP, as well as the demonstrated ability to monitor an effective global risk-based IT control environment.

• Are you looking to join a fast-paced, collaborative environment supporting a world class growing organization?
• Do you have the ability to think strategically and execute a complex project?
• Do you have a risk-based mindset?
• Are you IT savvy?
• Do you have the ability to drive change and improve awareness across the organization?

Role

• Support the execution of various SOX program components, including IT scoping, IT risk assessment, training of stakeholders on IT control-related best practices, IT control testing and review, remediation recommendations, deficiency evaluations and reporting
• Report to a US-based Manager, Risk Management
• Assess and determine design effectiveness of internal controls
• Experience covering multiple technology environments such as Mainframe, UNIX/Linux, Cloud and Windows environments
• Work with business owners to address any potential control gaps that may require remediation
• Partner with various business owners and IT teams including technology compliance, operations, development, and application support to provide expertise in assessing the design and effectiveness of IT controls
• Liaise with regional finance and IT stakeholders as well as internal and external auditors

Job Description: Accounts & Finance Manager (Chartered Accountant)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Chartered Accountant to lead our Finance & Accounts function. The Accounts & Finance Manager will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of accounting, financial reporting, taxation, budgeting, treasury, statutory compliance, audits, and internal controls. The role requires strong analytical abilities, leadership skills, and a strategic mindset to support business growth while ensuring compliance with all applicable financial and regulatory requirements.

The ideal candidate should possess extensive knowledge of Indian accounting standards, direct and indirect taxation, financial planning and analysis, ERP systems, and corporate governance. The candidate will work closely with senior management to drive financial efficiency, improve business performance, and support strategic decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Accounting & Reporting

- Manage the complete accounting function and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions.
- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in compliance with applicable accounting standards.
- Ensure timely book closure and preparation of trial balance, profit & loss account, balance sheet, and cash flow statements.
- Review general ledger balances and perform account reconciliations.
- Monitor fixed assets, depreciation schedules, and capital expenditure accounting.
- Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing activities.

2. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

- Ensure complete compliance with GST, TDS, Income Tax, Professional Tax, and other applicable statutory regulations.
- Review and file GST returns, TDS returns, Income Tax returns, and other statutory filings within prescribed timelines.
- Handle tax assessments, departmental notices, and litigation support.
- Coordinate with tax consultants and legal advisors for compliance and advisory matters.
- Monitor changes in tax laws and assess their impact on the organization.
- Ensure timely payment of statutory dues and maintain proper documentation.

3. Audit & Internal Controls

- Lead statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and cost audits.
- Coordinate with external auditors and ensure timely completion of audits.
- Implement recommendations arising from audit findings.
- Develop and strengthen internal financial controls and SOPs.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and statutory requirements.
- Conduct periodic financial risk assessments and recommend mitigation measures.

4. Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning

- Prepare annual operating budgets in consultation with department heads.
- Develop monthly and quarterly financial forecasts.
- Analyze budget versus actual performance and provide variance analysis.
- Support strategic financial planning and long-term business forecasting.
- Recommend cost optimization and profitability improvement initiatives.

5. Treasury & Cash Flow Management

- Monitor daily cash flow and liquidity requirements.
- Manage banking relationships and oversee fund management activities.
- Prepare cash flow forecasts and optimize working capital.
- Coordinate loan documentation, banking facilities, and financial instruments.
- Ensure efficient utilization of available funds.

6. MIS & Financial Analysis

- Prepare monthly MIS reports for senior management.
- Develop dashboards and KPI reports for business performance monitoring.
- Analyze profitability, margins, operating costs, and financial trends.
- Present financial insights to support strategic decision-making.
- Identify opportunities for revenue enhancement and cost reduction.

7. Accounts Payable & Receivable

- Monitor vendor payments and ensure timely settlement.
- Review customer receivables and coordinate collection activities.
- Ensure proper reconciliation of customer and vendor accounts.
- Improve receivable cycles and reduce outstanding balances.

8. ERP & Process Improvement

- Ensure effective utilization of ERP systems for finance operations.
- Participate in ERP implementation, upgrades, and process automation initiatives.
- Improve accounting processes through digitization and automation.
- Develop standardized financial procedures across business functions.

9. Team Management

- Lead, supervise, and mentor the finance and accounts team.
- Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.
- Conduct regular performance reviews and training sessions.
- Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.

10. Business Support

- Provide financial support for new projects, investments, and expansion initiatives.
- Conduct financial feasibility studies and investment analysis.
- Support management during mergers, acquisitions, fundraising, or due diligence activities.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

- Chartered Accountant (CA) .
